file_path.description: Path to the image or audio file suspected of containing hidden data. Must be jpg, jpeg, bmp, wav, or au.

wordlist.description: Path to the wordlist file containing candidate passwords, one per line.

output_file.description: Path where the decrypted secret will be written. Empty string uses default <input_file>.out.

threads.description: Number of concurrent threads for parallel processing.

chunk_size.description: Number of passwords loaded into memory per thread cycle.

quiet.description: If true, runs in quiet mode suppressing status updates.

verbose.description: If true, runs in verbose mode printing debugging info. Mutually exclusive with quiet.
